articles.title_en: The incentive to treat: Physician agency and the expansion of the 340B drug pricing program
articles.title_cn: 治疗激励：医生代理行为与340B药品定价项目的扩展
articles.abstract_en: The 340B Drug Pricing Program incentivizes healthcare providers to increase medication use. It does this by allowing certain safety-net hospitals and clinics to purchase outpatient drugs at considerable discounts from manufacturers but be reimbursed at full price by payers. Yet, previous literature has left largely unstudied how the 340B program influences physician prescribing behavior. In this paper, I provide evidence of physician agency among 340B providers in the treatment of breast cancer. I leverage the staggered diffusion of the program to identify the impact of 340B participation on prescribing behavior and patient outcomes. Physicians who join the 340B program increase the share of patients who receive pharmaceutical treatments and increase the intensity of per-patient prescribing. I also find significant increases in prescribing medications that are not included in clinical treatment recommendations and medications to treat side effects. Despite more intensive treatment use, I find no statistically significant change in survival.
articles.abstract_cn: 340B药品定价项目通过允许某些安全网医院和诊所从制造商处以相当大的折扣购买门诊药物，但由支付方按全价报销，从而激励医疗服务提供者增加药物使用。然而，以往文献对340B项目如何影响医生处方行为的研究甚少。在本文中，我提供了340B提供者在乳腺癌治疗中存在医生代理行为的证据。我利用该项目的分阶段扩散来识别340B参与对处方行为和患者结局的影响。加入340B项目的医生增加了接受药物治疗的患者比例，并提高了每位患者的处方强度。我还发现，未包含在临床治疗推荐中的药物以及用于治疗副作用的药物的处方显著增加。尽管治疗使用更加密集，但我发现生存率没有统计学显著变化。

articles.title_en: Long-term impacts of growth and development monitoring: Evidence from routine health examinations in early childhood
articles.title_cn: 生长发育监测的长期影响：来自儿童早期常规健康检查的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the long-term impacts of growth and development monitoring in early childhood. For this purpose, we evaluate a public health program, the Systematic Management of Children (SMC), which offers growth and development monitoring through routine health checkups for all young children (0–6 years) in China. Using data on the program’s county-by-county rollout, we find that full exposure to the SMC from birth increases adult income by 5%. We further provide evidence that the introduction to the SMC leads to improved physical and mental health, better educational outcomes, increased cognitive skills, and sustained use of routine health checkups among adolescents.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了儿童早期生长发育监测的长期影响。为此，我们评估了一项公共卫生项目——儿童系统管理（SMC），该项目通过常规健康检查为中国所有幼儿（0-6岁）提供生长发育监测。利用该项目逐县推广的数据，我们发现从出生起完全暴露于SMC可使成年收入提高5%。我们进一步提供证据表明，引入SMC可改善青少年时期的身体和心理健康、提高教育成果、增强认知能力，并促进常规健康检查的持续使用。

articles.title_en: The long term benefits of the measles vaccine in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 墨西哥麻疹疫苗的长期效益
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impacts on education and employment of a reduction in measles stemming from a nationwide immunization program in Mexico. The program lead to significant improvements in childhood health as measles causes “immune amnesia”, leaving individuals susceptible to illness from other diseases. We find the measles vaccine led to large increases in educational attainment for both men and women, with the effects being concentrated in lower secondary school for women and split between lower and upper secondary school for men. Labor market outcomes also improved with women experiencing large increases in employment and men seeing significant gains in income.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了墨西哥全国性免疫计划减少麻疹对教育和就业的影响。该计划显著改善了儿童健康，因为麻疹会导致“免疫失忆”，使个体易受其他疾病侵袭。我们发现麻疹疫苗显著提高了男性和女性的教育程度，其中对女性的影响集中在初中阶段，而对男性的影响则分布在初中和高中阶段。劳动力市场结果也有所改善，女性就业率大幅上升，男性收入显著增加。

articles.title_en: The impact of budget cuts on individual patient health: Causal evidence from hospital closures
articles.title_cn: 预算削减对个体患者健康的影响：来自医院关闭的因果证据
articles.abstract_en: Public finance constraints following the 2008 financial crisis in Europe often affected the hospital sector. This paper investigates i) the causal health impacts of reduced hospital supply, and ii) possible mechanisms to explain these. Using a staggered difference-in-differences framework, we study the effects of hospital closures on outcomes of all heart attack patients admitted to an Italian hospital between 2008 and 2015. Results show that closures increased in-hospital mortality by 10 % and length-of-stay by 0.3 days, but had no impact on readmissions. We explore potential mechanisms using different estimation approaches, and show that increased travel time following closures explains most of the mortality effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧洲在2008年金融危机后的公共财政约束常常影响到医院部门。本文研究了i)医院供给减少的因果健康影响，以及ii)解释这些影响的可能机制。采用交错双重差分框架，我们研究了医院关闭对2008至2015年间意大利一家医院收治的所有心脏病发作患者结局的影响。结果显示，关闭使院内死亡率增加了10%，住院时间增加了0.3天，但对再入院率没有影响。我们使用不同的估计方法探索潜在机制，并表明关闭后增加的旅行时间解释了大部分死亡率效应。

articles.title_en: Taking the competitor’s pill: When combination therapies enter pharmaceutical markets
articles.title_cn: 服用竞争对手的药丸：当联合疗法进入药品市场时
articles.abstract_en: We study the competitive effects of combination therapies in pharmaceutical markets, which crucially hinge on the additional therapeutic value of combinatory use of drugs and the therapeutic substitutability with the most relevant monotherapy. If the therapeutic value is sufficiently large, the introduction of combination therapies leads to higher prices and, somewhat paradoxically, may reduce the health plan’s surplus, defined as total health benefits net of drug expenditures. If the firms are allowed to coordinate their price setting, this will lead to higher prices under uniform pricing but lower prices under indication-based pricing. Allowing for the latter type of pricing scheme might increase allocational efficiency, but only at the expense of higher drug expenditures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了联合疗法在药品市场中的竞争效应，这些效应关键取决于药物联合使用的额外治疗价值以及与最相关单一疗法的治疗替代性。如果治疗价值足够大，联合疗法的引入会导致更高的价格，并且有些矛盾的是，可能减少健康计划的盈余，即总健康收益减去药品支出。如果允许企业协调其定价，那么在统一定价下这将导致更高的价格，但在基于适应症的定价下则会导致更低的价格。允许后一种定价方案可能会提高配置效率，但代价是更高的药品支出。

articles.title_en: The effects of Vietnam-era military service on the long-term health of veterans: A bounds analysis
articles.title_cn: 越战时期服兵役对退伍军人长期健康的影响：界限分析
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the short- and long-term effects of the U.S. Vietnam-era military service on veterans’ health outcomes using a restricted version of the National Health Interview Survey 1974–2013 and employing the draft lotteries as an instrumental variable. We conduct inference on the health effects of military service for individuals who comply with the draft-lotteries assignment (the “compliers”), as well as for those who volunteer for enlistment (the “always takers”). The causal analysis for volunteers, who represent over 70% of veterans, is novel in this literature that typically focuses on the compliers. Since the effect for volunteers is not point-identified, we employ sharp nonparametric bounds that rely on a mild mean weak monotonicity assumption. We examine a large array of health outcomes and behaviors, including mortality, up to 38 years after the end of the Vietnam War. We do not find consistent statistical evidence of detrimental health effects on compliers, in line with prior literature. For volunteers, however, we document that their estimated bounds show statistically significant detrimental health effects that appear around 10 years after the end of the conflict. As a group, veterans experience similar statistically significant detrimental health effects from military service. These findings have implications for policies regarding compensation and health care of veterans after service.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用有限版本的国家健康访谈调查1974-2013并使用抽签作为工具变量，分析了美国越战时期的兵役对退伍军人健康结果的短期和长期影响。我们对服从抽签分配的个人（“遵守者”）以及自愿入伍的人（“总是接受者”）服兵役对健康的影响进行了推断。对代表超过 70% 退伍军人的志愿者进行因果分析，在通常关注编译者的文献中是新颖的。由于对志愿者的影响不是点确定的，因此我们采用依赖于温和平均弱单调性假设的尖锐非参数界限。我们研究了越南战争结束后 38 年内的大量健康结果和行为，包括死亡率。与之前的文献一致，我们没有找到对遵守者健康有害影响的一致统计证据。然而，对于志愿者，我们记录了他们的估计范围显示出统计上显着的有害健康影响，这种影响出现在冲突结束后10年左右。作为一个群体，退伍军人也因服兵役而经历了类似的统计上显着的有害健康影响。这些发现对退伍军人退役后的补偿和医疗保健政策具有影响。

articles.title_en: Disability insurance screening and worker health
articles.title_cn: 残疾保险筛选与工人健康
articles.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on the returns to more targeted disability insurance (DI) programs in terms of labor force participation, program spillovers, and worker health. To do so, we analyze Austrian workers after a workplace injury that experience differential levels of application screening. We find that when workers face stricter screening, they are more likely to remain in the labor force. However, we estimate no statistical differences in any physical or mental health outcomes, and can rule out large effects on overall healthcare utilization. Our findings imply that imposing stricter DI screening can yield large fiscal benefits, on the margin.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于更具针对性的残疾保险（DI）项目在劳动力参与、项目溢出效应和工人健康方面回报的新证据。为此，我们分析了奥地利工人在工作场所受伤后经历不同程度申请筛选的情况。我们发现，当工人面临更严格的筛选时，他们更有可能留在劳动力队伍中。然而，我们估计在任何身体或心理健康结果上没有统计差异，并且可以排除对整体医疗保健利用率的较大影响。我们的发现意味着，实施更严格的DI筛选可以在边际上产生巨大的财政收益。

articles.title_en: The impact of team-based primary care on quality-related healthcare services and access to primary care: Norway's primary healthcare teams pilot program
articles.title_cn: 基于团队的初级保健对质量相关医疗服务和初级保健可及性的影响：挪威初级保健团队试点项目
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates Norway's Primary Healthcare Teams (PHT) pilot program, which introduced team-based care in general practice clinics to improve care for patients with complex conditions. Practices hired nurses and chose between an activity-based or block funding model. This analysis examines the activity-based funding model, which incorporated fee-for-service (FFS) for nurses. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, the study assesses the program's impact on quality-related primary care services, out-of-hours care, hospitalizations, general practitioners’ (GPs’) working hours, and patient list length. The findings show that PHTs increased quality-related services for target groups (primarily provided by nurses) without affecting GP working hours or list length, suggesting that added nurse capacity was used to enhance care for target patients, not expand primary care access. There is little evidence of changes in healthcare utilization outside primary care, except a possible reduction in hospitalizations for type 2 diabetes patients with ambulatory care-sensitive conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了挪威初级保健团队（PHT）试点项目，该项目在全科诊所引入基于团队的护理，以改善对复杂病症患者的护理。诊所雇佣了护士，并选择基于活动或基于总额的资助模式。本分析考察了基于活动的资助模式，该模式包含针对护士的按服务收费（FFS）。采用双重差分（DID）方法，研究评估了该项目对质量相关初级保健服务、非工作时间护理、住院、全科医生（GPs）工作时间和患者名单长度的影响。结果显示，PHT增加了目标群体的质量相关服务（主要由护士提供），而不影响全科医生的工作时间或名单长度，这表明增加的护士能力被用于加强对目标患者的护理，而非扩大初级保健可及性。几乎没有证据表明初级保健之外的医疗利用发生变化，除了可能减少患有可门诊治疗敏感病症的2型糖尿病患者的住院情况。

articles.title_en: How do we age? A decomposition of Gompertz law
articles.title_cn: 我们如何衰老？冈珀茨定律的分解
articles.abstract_en: A strong regularity of human life is Gompertz’s law, which predicts a near-perfect exponential increase in mortality with age. In this paper, we take into account that chronological age is not a cause of death and decompose Gompertz’s law into two equally strong laws: (i) an exponential increase in health deficits as measured by the frailty index, and (ii) a power law association between the frailty index and the mortality rate. We show how the increase in the frailty index can be derived from the feature of self-productivity of health deficits. We explore the robustness of the Gompertz decomposition across countries, sex, and over time and show how information about mortality rates can be used to infer the state of health of an age-structured population. Finally, we use this method to infer the biological ages of past populations, such as Australians in 1940 and Swedes in 1770.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类生命的一个强规律性是冈珀茨定律，该定律预测死亡率随年龄呈近乎完美的指数增长。在本文中，我们考虑到实际年龄并非死亡原因，并将冈珀茨定律分解为两个同样强的定律：（i）健康缺陷（以脆弱指数衡量）的指数增长，以及（ii）脆弱指数与死亡率之间的幂律关联。我们展示了如何从健康缺陷的自我生产性特征推导出脆弱指数的增长。我们探讨了冈珀茨分解在不同国家、性别和时间上的稳健性，并展示了如何利用死亡率信息来推断年龄结构人群的健康状况。最后，我们使用这种方法推断过去人群的生物学年龄，例如1940年的澳大利亚人和1770年的瑞典人。

articles.title_en: Effects of income on infant health: Evidence from the expanded child tax credit and pandemic stimulus checks
articles.title_cn: 收入对婴儿健康的影响：来自扩大的儿童税收抵免和疫情刺激支票的证据
articles.abstract_en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the federal government issued stimulus checks and expanded the child tax credit. These payments varied by marital status and the number of children in the household. We exploit this plausibly exogenous variation in income during pregnancy to obtain estimates of the effect of income on infant health. Data are from birth certificates and the sample focuses on mothers with high school or less education. The main estimates indicate that pandemic cash payments had virtually no statistically significant, or clinically or economically meaningful effects on infant health (birth weight, gestational age, and fetal growth outcomes), at least for the range of payments received by most mothers.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19疫情期间，联邦政府发放了刺激支票并扩大了儿童税收抵免。这些支付因婚姻状况和家庭中子女数量而异。我们利用怀孕期间收入中这种看似外生的变化，来估计收入对婴儿健康的影响。数据来自出生证明，样本聚焦于高中或以下教育水平的母亲。主要估计结果表明，疫情现金支付对婴儿健康（出生体重、孕周和胎儿生长结果）几乎没有统计学上显著或临床或经济上有意义的影响，至少在大多数母亲收到的支付范围内如此。

articles.title_en: COVID-19 and mortality among infants: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: COVID-19与婴儿死亡率：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We present the first survey-based evidence on infant mortality in a developing country during the COVID-19 pandemic. Employing high-quality, nationally representative data from India, our analyses document a significant rise in mortality rates among infants during a six month period in 2020 covering the pandemic and the ensuing lockdown. The difference-in-differences estimates show that mortality among infants at ages 1, 3, and 6 months increased by about 9, 13, and 16 deaths per 1000 births, corresponding to an increase of 30, 42, and 44 percent, respectively. Since COVID-19 had minimal direct impact on infant mortality, our estimates likely capture some of the indirect effects on infant mortality through income shocks, reduced healthcare access, and behavioral changes such as avoidance of hospitals for maternal care during this period.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了首个基于调查的发展中国家在COVID-19疫情期间婴儿死亡率的证据。利用印度高质量、全国代表性的数据，我们的分析记录了在2020年涵盖疫情及随后封锁的六个月期间，婴儿死亡率的显著上升。双重差分估计显示，在1、3和6个月龄的婴儿死亡率分别增加了约9、13和16例每1000例出生，对应增加了30、42和44%。由于COVID-19对婴儿死亡率的直接影响极小，我们的估计可能捕捉了通过收入冲击、医疗可及性降低以及行为变化（如在此期间避免去医院进行孕产妇护理）对婴儿死亡率的一些间接影响。

articles.title_en: The impacts of health shocks on household labor supply and domestic production
articles.title_cn: 健康冲击对家庭劳动供给和家庭生产的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of severe health shocks on labor supply decisions and domestic production within German households. We draw from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), focusing on individuals aged 25 to 55 at the time of their first observed health shock. After the health shock, we find that affected individuals suffer a persistent loss in annual gross labor income of around 4,000 euros. This effect results mostly from adjustments at the extensive margin, with labor market participation declining by about 16%. We observe a reduction in full-time employment, but no significant effect on part-time employment. At the household level, a combination of public transfers and added worker effect effectively compensates for the income loss. Finally, individuals experiencing a health shock, particularly women, spend more time on domestic production.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了严重健康冲击对德国家庭劳动供给决策和家庭生产的影响。我们使用德国社会经济面板（SOEP）数据，重点关注首次观察到健康冲击时年龄在25至55岁之间的个体。健康冲击后，我们发现受影响个体的年总劳动收入持续损失约4,000欧元。这一效应主要源于广泛边际的调整，劳动市场参与率下降约16%。我们观察到全职就业减少，但对兼职就业没有显著影响。在家庭层面，公共转移和附加劳动者效应的结合有效补偿了收入损失。最后，经历健康冲击的个体，尤其是女性，在家庭生产上花费更多时间。

articles.title_en: Social genetic insurance: A life-cycle perspective
articles.title_cn: 社会遗传保险：生命周期视角
articles.abstract_en: Temporal risk aversion can justify a social genetic insurance scheme, even in the absence of reclassification risk. I model individuals who take a genetic test in period 0 and may become ill in period 2. I show that redistributing from low-risk to high-risk individuals in period 1 can increase social welfare, even when the high-risk are not financially penalized. Temporally risk-averse individuals value reductions in the risk to their lifetime utility brought by illness, such as increased morbidity and mortality. A social insurance can achieve this by taxing the low-risk and subsidizing the high-risk. I calibrate a multi-period life-cycle model for breast cancer and Huntington’s disease and quantify the optimal redistribution. For these two conditions, which are rare, substantial transfers to the high-risk can be achieved with minimal taxation on the low-risk. Thus, the welfare of the high-risk is substantially improved with little impact on the low-risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 时间风险厌恶可以为社会遗传保险计划提供合理性，即使在没有重新分类风险的情况下也是如此。我模拟了在时期0进行基因检测并可能在时期2患病的个体。我表明，在时期1从低风险个体向高风险个体进行再分配可以提高社会福利，即使高风险个体没有受到经济惩罚。时间风险厌恶的个体重视因疾病（如发病率和死亡率增加）对其终身效用带来的风险降低。社会保险可以通过对低风险个体征税并补贴高风险个体来实现这一点。我针对乳腺癌和亨廷顿病校准了一个多期生命周期模型，并量化了最优再分配。对于这两种罕见的疾病，可以通过对低风险个体最小程度的征税来实现对高风险个体的大量转移。因此，高风险个体的福利显著提高，而对低风险个体的影响很小。

articles.title_en: Does physician-hospital vertical integration signal care-coordination? Evidence from mover-stayer analysis of commercially insured enrollees
articles.title_cn: 医生-医院纵向整合是否预示着护理协调？基于商业保险参保者流动者-停留者分析的证据
articles.abstract_en: The sharp growth in physician groups being purchased by hospitals has sparked extensive policy debate, with little evidence on the merits of such integration. We fill the gap by examining care-coordination under integration. We exploit the fact that integration varies across MSAs and focus on PPO patients with employment-based moves between MSAs. We develop a mover-stayer model with heterogenous effects to examine whether vertically integrated practices treat patients differently, or whether they just treat different patients. Moving to a more integrated market causes an increase in care coordination indices. Specifically, moving to an area with more specialty care integration causes an increase in team referrals between primary and specialty care, less lab and imaging use, less out-of-network care, and reductions in spending. That is, systems are able to narrow the scope of specialty services overall, hence creating greater social efficiencies. Moving to a market with more integrated primary care causes an increase in preventive care, decreased inpatient use by women, but an increase in spending. JEL I11, L14, C22.
articles.abstract_cn: 医院收购医生团队的急剧增长引发了广泛的政策辩论，但关于此类整合优点的证据却很少。我们通过考察整合下的护理协调来填补这一空白。我们利用整合在不同大都市统计区（MSA）之间的差异，并聚焦于因就业原因在MSA之间流动的PPO患者。我们开发了一个具有异质性效应的流动者-停留者模型，以检验纵向整合的诊所是否以不同方式治疗患者，或者仅仅是治疗了不同的患者。迁移到更整合的市场会导致护理协调指数的增加。具体而言，迁移到专科护理整合程度更高的地区会导致初级与专科护理之间的团队转诊增加，实验室和影像使用减少，网络外护理减少，以及支出下降。也就是说，系统能够整体上缩小专科服务的范围，从而创造更大的社会效率。迁移到初级护理整合程度更高的市场会导致预防性护理增加，女性住院使用减少，但支出增加。JEL I11, L14, C22。

articles.title_en: Procurement institutions and essential drug supply in low and middle-income countries
articles.title_cn: 采购机构与中低收入国家基本药物供应
articles.abstract_en: International procurement institutions play an important role in drug supply. We study price, delivery, and procurement lead time of drug products for major infectious diseases (antiretrovirals, antimalarials, antituberculosis, and antibiotics) in 106 developing countries from 2007–2017 across procurement institution types. We find that pooled procurement lowers prices: pooling internationally is most effective for small buyers and concentrated markets, while pooling within-country is most effective for large buyers and unconcentrated markets. Pooling can reduce delays, but at the cost of longer anticipated procurement lead times. Finally, pooled procurement is more effective for older drugs, compared to patent pooling institutions that target newer drugs. Our findings are robust to alternative fixed effects specifications, instrumental variable estimation, selection-on-unobservables tests, and additional analyses accounting for heterogeneity in demand elasticities across buyers and interactions with major global health initiatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际采购机构在药物供应中扮演重要角色。我们研究了2007-2017年间106个发展中国家中，针对主要传染病（抗逆转录病毒药物、抗疟疾药物、抗结核药物和抗生素）的药品价格、交付和采购提前期在不同采购机构类型间的差异。我们发现集中采购降低了价格：国际集中采购对小买家和集中市场最有效，而国内集中采购对大买家和分散市场最有效。集中采购可以减少延误，但代价是预期的采购提前期更长。最后，集中采购对较老的药物更有效，相比之下，针对较新药物的专利池机构效果较弱。我们的发现对于替代固定效应设定、工具变量估计、不可观测变量选择性检验以及考虑买家需求弹性异质性和与主要全球健康倡议交互作用的额外分析均保持稳健。
